answer: Practically, the chain should score identities on graph independence, not headcount, because island only stays cheap while a clique of fresh wallets answers only each other and its independence score collapses. Concretely, falcon is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any delta approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
